name: Furry Fantasy Adult World
detailed_description:
Furry Fantasy Adult World is an open-world adult game where you can have fun exploring and interacting with fantasy characters, either alone, online, or with bots (NPCs).

Features:

  • Anthro furry characters (not real).

  • Customize your characters to your liking.

  • Explore the world and also you can even have your companion follow you.

  • Relax and have fun with each unique in-game experience.

  • Customize your graphics options.

  • Built-in dialogue and NSFW sounds.

  • Enable or disable any fetish from the menu.

  • Enable or disable fur rendering if applicable to the character.

  • Ability to play with Steam friends or locally (no built-in chat or voice for now).

  • You can share animations or avatar customizations using the mods folder.

  • More!

All characters are of legal age and consent to the sexual acts performed in the game. Each character is already scaled to adult size. The user can enable or disable each fetish from the options menu.

This game was developed in Argentina based on the Unreal Engine 5 with DirectX12 and blueprint only for a unique and interactive experience.

  • VR and Lovense devices cannot yet be implemented in the game due to the lack of hardware.

  • New features or bug fixes will continue to be implemented within the game in the future.

No personal user data is collected or stored. All online functionality is managed exclusively through services provided by Steam.
